entities.name: Lucien von Römer
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lucien Sophie Albert Marie von Römer was a Dutch physician, botanist and writer. He often wrote about homosexuality, and argued that it was an innate characteristic. He practiced medicine in the Dutch East Indies in his later life. His views parallel those of psychiatrist Sigmund Freud on this topic.
